title: FERC Order 1920 Implementation
thesisImpact: FERC Order 1920 (issued May 2024) requires regional transmission organizations to conduct 20-year forward-looking planning. Compliance filings and planning studies are ongoing through 2026.

title: DOE Loan Programs Office Disbursements
thesisImpact: The DOE Loan Programs Office has authority to issue loans and loan guarantees for nuclear, grid, and clean energy projects. Disbursement decisions affect project financing timelines.

title: FERC large-load interconnection ANOPR decision
thesisImpact: FERC must act by end of June 2026 on the DOE-initiated Advance Notice of Proposed Rulemaking for large-load interconnection. Outcome shapes how datacenter loads connect to the grid and how cost is allocated.

title: PJM Expedited Interconnection Track (EIT) effective
thesisImpact: PJM's Expedited Interconnection Track targets July 31, 2026 effective date. Up to 10 fast-track approvals per year for large new or uprated capacity resources.

title: Large Power Transformer Trade Policy Review
thesisImpact: US trade policy on large power transformer imports affects domestic supply availability. The US imports a significant share of LPTs, and tariff changes impact grid equipment procurement timelines.

title: Three Mile Island Unit 1 Restart Progress
thesisImpact: Constellation Energy is pursuing restart of TMI Unit 1 (837 MW) under a power purchase agreement with Microsoft. NRC review and regulatory approvals continue toward a 2027-2028 target restart.

title: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings (typical reporting week)
thesisImpact: NVIDIA's quarterly print is the dominant signal for AI-infra demand. Guidance on Blackwell ramps, datacenter mix, and capex absorption sets the tone for the entire stack.

title: Texas SB6 large-load interconnection rules effective
thesisImpact: PUCT-issued rules under SB6 set interconnection standards for ERCOT loads of 75 MW or more. Study fees of $100k-$300k. Slows speculative interconnection requests; shifts cost discovery up-front.

title: LBNL Queued Up 2026 Edition published
thesisImpact: Lawrence Berkeley National Lab published the 2026 edition in May 2026, covering interconnection queues through the end of 2025: about 8,200 active projects, 1,312 GW of generation and about 749 GW of storage.
